protocol.description: One turn of improving the improvement loop itself: the loop scorecard, computed over at least three recorded self.improvement turns, shows a metric below its target on the promoted loop definition (the scenario corpus, the metric definitions, the review panel, the intake rules, the protocols and the agent profiles); a candidate change to the loop is delivered; the candidate is checked not to redefine a metric without reporting the previous definition beside it; the owner, or a role the owner delegated the grant to on record, merges it; and after at least three further turns under the candidate the metric is compared again. Accepted once the metric improved; declined when it did not. Every change to the loop is a judge-surface change, so its merge needs the owner's grant or that of a role the owner delegated it to by a revocable record; a revoked delegation grants nothing (story:judge-guard enforces it).
